---
name: value-equality-and-hashing
description: Give structs typed equality with IEquatable<T>, matching
  GetHashCode, == and != operators, and an optional constructor-cached hash so
  dictionary and HashSet operations stop boxing. Use when writing a struct that
  will be a dictionary key or set element, when the profiler shows boxing
  allocations in collection lookups, or when default struct equality
  (reflection-based) is showing up in a hot path.
